label: TypeScript and JavaScript migration drift (Prisma)
description: prisma migrate diff --from-migrations --to-schema --exit-code tells whether the schema changed without a migration, against the services database (the shadow database of prisma.config, a second database of the services). Comes in by evidence: prisma/schema.prisma; runs only where migration is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
